revision: R1 (2026-08-24): labels reconciled with the design doc; all doses above 100 umol/kg are strictly stress tests until mesocosm sourcing is verified

tiers.deployment_relevant: 10-100 umol/kg; perturbations comparable to near-field, post-dilution deployment conditions (Renforth & Henderson 2017; NASEM 2021 - to verify before locking)
tiers.exploratory_stress_test: 150-500 umol/kg; believed comparable to mesocosm/laboratory additions but NOT asserted as such until the mesocosm delta-TA sourcing is verified (currently SOURCE VERIFICATION REQUIRED); until then described only as model stress tests

reporting_policy: Headline deployment-relevant conclusions (including any recommended dose window) are computed on the 0-100 umol/kg tier only.
Results from the 150-500 umol/kg tier are reported separately as model-behavior characterization (e.g., where precipitation-risk ranges are entered), never as deployment predictions.
design_notes: Extends beyond the brief's original 0-300 umol/kg range to 500 umol/kg so that precipitation-risk ranges, if entered at all, appear inside the modeled range rather than at its edge (cold, low-saturation-state waters may not enter risk ranges below 300 umol/kg).
Every environment draw (env_id) is paired with the full 12-level ladder, enabling within-environment marginal-efficiency calculations without confounding by environment.
Marginal efficiency is defined on POTENTIAL (thermodynamic) uptake so the sampled kinetic equilibration fraction cannot contaminate the diminishing-returns analysis.
verification_needed: Exact mesocosm/experimental delta-TA ranges for the 150-500 umol/kg tier: SOURCE VERIFICATION REQUIRED. Until located, that tier is labeled strictly as model stress tests.
